result.title: GLOBE: Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit via Unit-Sphere Trajectories
result.summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve problem solving, but models often keep generating after the correct answer is already reachable; the extra steps raise serving costs and may replace a correct intermediate result with an incorrect one. We propose GLOBE (Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit), an online, training-free algorithm that terminates the model's CoT process early. GLOBE embeds each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reads the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. GLOBE first applies a trial phase that generates short trial answers in a separate branch, stopping the main stream on an accepted trial after checking confidence against a threshold. If generation continues, a trajectory phase stops the stream once this path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. On five benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0% across two models, and achieves a five-task average of 80.58%, comparable to Full CoT.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的在线提前退出算法 GLOBE：将每段已完成的推理嵌入单位球面，通过试答分支的置信阈值与轨迹方向反复逆转、净进展很小的几何信号决定是否终止 CoT；在数学推理、工具调用、智能体记忆等五个基准上约减少 49.7% 输出 token 与 51.0% 端到端耗时。
AI.relevance_reason: 其基于语义轨迹几何形状的在线停止判据，可能为 LVR 关注的 STOP 决策与动态计算成本控制提供方法线索，可供核查；但对象是纯文本 CoT，能否迁移到多模态 latent 推理状态尚不确定。
